second_order: pulling standalone April Fools tricks on fellow players
theme_note: These passages make self-contained false unlocks, updates, or deletion gambits and then reveal, limit, or assess the trick; what varies is who initiates it and how quickly others call it.

second_order: turning the subreddit into an April Fools theme and calling time on it
theme_note: These passages change or notice the banner and flair environment, explain what the subreddit-wide joke is doing, and later assess or close it; they range from moderator decisions to member enjoyment, fatigue, and avoidance.

second_order: having AutoModerator enforce the joke flairs
theme_note: The moderators' bot removes or approves posts under the Meta, Gacha, and No Gacha rules; what varies is the named commandment or god, the tag tested, and whether the post passes.

second_order: posting and reposting through Meta, Gacha and No Gacha
theme_note: Members perform the inverted unit talk, retag ordinary questions, resubmit removed material, and otherwise work inside or around the imposed flair joke; surface subjects vary, while adapting the post to the joke holds the codes together.

second_order: building and celebrating a smaller Basic Cat
theme_note: These passages recruit builders, resize the design for a smaller community, link people back to the project, mark visible progress, locate it, and celebrate doing it; the practice develops from call to claimed completion.

second_order: taking the cat project to Discord and asking other subreddits for room
theme_note: Organisers move some live talk to a temporary Discord and ask or propose asking named subreddits for space; the venue and visibility of the other side vary, while seeking room outside the thread is common.

second_order: finding another spot after the void and griefers
theme_note: Builders avoid damaging nearby work and answer lost space by weighing resistance, reuse, and relocation; later passages add exposure, permission, moderation, and colour constraints.

second_order: asking what to draw after finishing the cat
theme_note: After treating the cat as complete or changed into Killer Cat, participants ask whether to go further and propose Pikotaro, a clown addition, Aphrodite, or baby Mitama; proposals vary and no shared next drawing is established.
